summary_en: 1,400,000 shares (2.34% of shares ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥4,040/share (closing price 31 July 2026) for ¥5,656M total. Settlement 3 August 2026. Subsequent cancellation of all 1,400,000 newly acquired shares plus 2,000,000 existing treasury shares (3,400,000 total, 3.25% of pre-cancellation issued shares) effective 31 August 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase via off-auction traded (ToSTNeT-3) treasury share trading, and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, the board of Nippon Densetsu Kogyo resolved to acquire and cancel treasury shares under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1,400,000 common shares via off-auction ToSTNeT-3 trading at the 31 July closing price of ¥4,040 per share (comprising the final special quote), for a maximum of ¥5,656M. The acquisition order will be placed on the morning of 3 August 2026 at 8:45 am and will be limited to that trading session only. Results will be published immediately after the close of trading on 3 August. The company will then cancel all 1,400,000 newly acquired shares together with 2,000,000 existing treasury shares (3,400,000 shares total) on 31 August 2026. The board cited sustained growth in enterprise value and enhanced capital efficiency, coupled with further returns to shareholders, as the rationale. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 1,624,146 treasury shares against 59,913,073 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
